title: DecisionRequest
description: What an agent submits via request_decision. Nod adds id, status, timestamps, classification and audit fields on its side. Field limits on `glance` exist so cards fit the Even G2 576x288 display.

idempotency_key.description: Agent-chosen key; resubmitting the same key returns the existing decision instead of creating a duplicate.

ref.description: Source-native identifier, e.g. Paperclip issue/approval id, PR number, email thread id.

project.description: Work area, e.g. dental-web-jobs, hum, fam-central, plgrm.

kind.description: external = triggered by input from outside David's systems (e.g. an inbound email).

origin.description: e.g. sender address for an inbound email.

impact.description: Plain-language effect on people (end users, clients, David). Leads the detail view. No technical jargon.

outcome.description: What happens for people if chosen.

writes.description: True if choosing this performs any external write (send, deploy, delete, spend, modify).

default.description: What the agent will do if unanswered. Deadline pauses outside open hours unless urgent.

fingerprint.description: Opaque precondition token from the source (revision, branch SHA, thread last-message id, deploy id). Nod re-reads the source and compares before writing an answer.

resources.description: Lock keys this decision would act on, e.g. env:dental-staging, email-thread:abc123, branch:repo/name.

tried.description: What the agent already tried or researched. Used to brief Call Me.

ttl_seconds.description: Request expires unless the agent heartbeats.
